name: app/quick-search
title: QuickSearch
summary: The sidebar's search button with its ⌘K hint. It opens a CommandPalette through the Popover API, so it works with no script.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and visible text ("Quick search…").

behaviour: A <button popovertarget> that opens the palette with no script.
Advertises the ⌘K / Ctrl+K shortcut with aria-keyshortcuts; the visible hint is decorative (aria-hidden) and shows from lg.
The palette's script swaps the hint to "Ctrl K" off Apple platforms.

keyboard: Enter or Space opens the palette.
⌘K / Ctrl+K anywhere opens it (with the palette's script).

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: The button opens the palette through the Popover API.
noJs.with: The shortcut lives in CommandPalette's script.

responsive: Fills the sidebar's width; the ⌘K hint shows from lg; in the collapsed rail only the icon shows.
contract:
contract
  slot is "quick-search"
  label is "Quick search"
  button "Quick search" min_height 32
  when custom label is "Search"
end
